parse_and_load_from_model: build an argparse parser then call parse_and_load_from_model to load model args from args.json
train_args: run train_args to parse command line arguments for training a diffusion model
generate_args: run generate_args to parse command line arguments for sampling from a trained model
add_model_options: build an argparse parser and call add_model_options to add model hyperparameters like layers and heads
add_diffusion_options: build an argparse parser and call add_diffusion_options to add noise schedule and diffusion steps
